title: Ocean Fresh Portuguese Fish Wrap
description: A citrusy and comforting Portuguese dish featuring pineapple chunks, served in a ssam-wrap with fresh fish, perfect for pescatarian diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fillets with salt, pepper, and garlic.
Drizzle the olive oil over the cod fillets and bake for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the lemon juice in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the pineapple chunks to the saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the ssam wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing a piece of cod, some pineapple chunks, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper in the center of each wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
